_comment: Single current-audit source of truth for CoreTend 0.8.1, distinct from CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.json. AUDIT_PACKAGE_COMMIT is recorded post-hoc after each external ZIP build and is never conflated with the other commit fields (see Scripts/compute-audit-commits.sh). The 0.8.0 version of this file is frozen at Documentation/AuditHistory/0.8.0/CURRENT_AUDIT_STATE.json and must not be edited to match this one.

commitIdentities.note_FINAL_REPOSITORY_HEAD: The final commit of this phase cannot contain its own SHA. The authoritative value is written into AUDIT_PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json at the root of the external audit package, built from a staging directory after that commit exists. Verify locally with `git rev-parse HEAD` on a clean tree.
commitIdentities.note_PRODUCT_SOURCE_COMMIT: The commit the audited ZIP/DMG were actually built from, as recorded by Scripts/build-release.sh into Release/latest.json and asserted by Scripts/test-release-manifest.sh against the real git HEAD at build time.
commitIdentities.note_AUDIT_PACKAGE_COMMIT: Equals FINAL_REPOSITORY_HEAD for this phase. Filled in by the packaging step, after a `git status --short` check proves the tree was clean immediately before zipping.

commitClassificationAfterTheSourceOfTheA._comment: Answers the question 'did anything that enters the app, the bundle, its resources, or the distributed site change after the commit the binaries came from?' Verified with git diff-tree per commit, not assumed.

commits.subject: release: 0.8.1 — CoreTend Rebrand & Workspace Migration
commits.siteImpact: YES — Website/generate.py and the generated legal pages
commits.auditImpact: YES — Release/SHA256SUMS, Release/latest.json, release notes, PROJECT_STATE.json

commits.subject: docs: record the executed phase and publish the workspace-facing copies
fix(privacy): stop the private-data gate from being the leak it looks for

commitClassificationAfterTheSourceOfTheA.conclusion: The compiled code is unchanged from 3b5dc73 through 92cbd08. Bundle metadata and the distributed site last changed at dec47a1, which is why the artifacts' Info.plist correctly reads 0.8.1 even though the build ran while git HEAD was still 3b5dc73 — the 0.8.1 changes were present in the working tree and were committed 8 minutes later. Release/latest.json's stale sourceCommit 3b5dc73 was the visible symptom of exactly that gap.
commitClassificationAfterTheSourceOfTheA.rebuildDecision: Rebuilt. Not by choice: Scripts/test-release-manifest.sh is a mandatory gate and calls Scripts/build-release.sh as part of its own resync regression check. The rebuild is also what corrected the provenance defect, so sourceCommit now equals the real HEAD at build time.

coherenceChecks.note: Declarations and executed counts match exactly. The single parameterized @Test (4 arguments) is counted as one test by Swift Testing and runs as 4 cases, giving 278 executed cases.

gateResults._comment: Every value below is the real exit status of a real run on 2026-07-25, not a carried-forward claim.
gateResults.check-legacy-brand-references: PASS (after this phase's fix — it was FAIL at 92cbd08)
gateResults.test-release-manifest: PASS (rebuilds artifacts as a side effect)

reasons: Placeholder tokens still present across docs, legal pages and the site generator — no legal identity or security contact has been decided
No trademark search has been run for 'CoreTend'; Documentation/BRAND_SEARCH_EVIDENCE.md states this explicitly rather than leaving an empty conflict table to be misread as a clean result
publicationGate.note: These are human decisions, not automatable work. This gate must never be wired into normal CI as a blocking step.

done: Non-destructive launch smoke test from a temp directory outside the repository
DMG mounts, contains the app and an /Applications shortcut
blocked: Full FR/EN x light/dark x every-module campaign
DMG saved icon positions (Finder automation refused)

auditPackages.note: Four-commit manifest, but no AUDIT_PACKAGE_README.md, no SHA256SUMS, no FILELIST, and AUDIT_PACKAGE_COMMIT still absent from its manifest

auditPackages.status: HISTORICAL — superseded by the 0.8.1 FINAL package
auditPackages.note: Correct and immutable for its own commit 8acd2a5. Its snapshot is preserved verbatim in Documentation/AuditHistory/0.8.0/CURRENT_AUDIT_STATE.json, including the reasoning for why it was deliberately not advanced to the later doc-only HEAD a3fe7f7.

Built from a separate staging directory outside the repository so that creating it cannot dirty the tree. Its AUDIT_PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json carries the authoritative FINAL_REPOSITORY_HEAD and AUDIT_PACKAGE_COMMIT.

knownNonConformitiesAtThisCommit: Public release placeholders not filled in (Scripts/check-publish-readiness.sh)
No trademark search for the product name
Migration executed for real once, on one machine, on the happy path (Documentation/CORETEND_DATA_MIGRATION_REPORT.md §5)
Scripts/test-distribution.sh launch check is not isolated from the real per-user store (Documentation/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md)
Scripts/test-release-manifest.sh cannot be green at the commit that records its own output (Documentation/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md)
